notes: S2-FIX4 F83 (decision 2026-11-16 #4; §5.3, §11.3): container/previous-device-key-target-context with the target's device declaration altered after signing (its owner names another key, the file keeps its listed name). Both of its signatures fail their equations, so under §5.3 it supplies no material of any kind, the manifest signature's included: the manifest entry by the device key is judged as an undeclared key's, E_KEY_UNKNOWN (unverifiable, the pipeline goes on), and no check used context material (no L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU). The records listing then stops the container with E_MANIFEST_RECORD_DIGEST (records: []), before the previous-manifest stage.
